# Agent, tool, and sandbox packages

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-plugin-catalog.ts. Run `pnpm generate:plugin-catalog`. -->

Packages with a skill ship their own `SKILL.md`. Once the package is
installed, read `node_modules/<package>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` instead of
guessing at the API. Packages without one are documented at
https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs and in their own `src` directory, which
ships in the published package.

| Package                              | Skills                                                                                                                                                                   | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@tanstack/ai-acp`                   | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Shared Agent Client Protocol (ACP) transport, session, and AG-UI translation for TanStack AI harness adapters.                                                                                                                     |
| `@tanstack/ai-claude-code`           | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Claude Code harness adapter for TanStack AI — run Claude Code as a chat backend with local tool execution and stateful sessions.                                                                                                   |
| `@tanstack/ai-code-mode`             | `ai-code-mode`                                                                                                                                                           | Secure TypeScript Code Mode for TanStack AI agents to execute sandboxed tool orchestration programs.                                                                                                                               |
| `@tanstack/ai-code-mode-snippets`    | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Persistent runtime snippet library for TanStack AI Code Mode agents and sandboxed tool orchestration.                                                                                                                              |
| `@tanstack/ai-codex`                 | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Codex harness adapter for TanStack AI — run OpenAI Codex as a chat backend with local tool execution and stateful sessions.                                                                                                        |
| `@tanstack/ai-grok-build`            | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Grok Build harness adapter for TanStack AI — run Grok Build as a chat backend with local tool execution and stateful sessions.                                                                                                     |
| `@tanstack/ai-isolate-cloudflare`    | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Cloudflare Workers sandbox driver for TanStack AI Code Mode TypeScript execution at the edge.                                                                                                                                      |
| `@tanstack/ai-isolate-daytona`       | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Daytona sandbox driver for TanStack AI Code Mode TypeScript execution.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `@tanstack/ai-isolate-node`          | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Node.js isolated-vm sandbox driver for TanStack AI Code Mode TypeScript execution.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `@tanstack/ai-isolate-quickjs`       | —                                                                                                                                                                        | QuickJS WASM sandbox driver for TanStack AI Code Mode TypeScript execution across runtimes.                                                                                                                                        |
| `@tanstack/ai-isolate-quickjs-bun`   | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Native QuickJS sandbox driver for TanStack AI Code Mode TypeScript execution on Bun via bun:ffi.                                                                                                                                   |
| `@tanstack/ai-mcp`                   | `ai-mcp`                                                                                                                                                                 | Host-side Model Context Protocol client for TanStack AI: discover and run MCP server tools, resources, and prompts in any adapter's chat() loop, with generated end-to-end types.                                                  |
| `@tanstack/ai-memory`                | `tanstack-ai-memory`, `tanstack-ai-memory-hindsight`, `tanstack-ai-memory-honcho`, `tanstack-ai-memory-in-memory`, `tanstack-ai-memory-mem0`, `tanstack-ai-memory-redis` | Pluggable memory adapters for TanStack AI memoryMiddleware                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `@tanstack/ai-opencode`              | —                                                                                                                                                                        | OpenCode harness adapter for TanStack AI — run OpenCode as a chat backend with local tool execution and stateful sessions.                                                                                                         |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox`               | `ai-sandbox`                                                                                                                                                             | Provider-agnostic sandbox layer for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside isolated sandboxes (defineSandbox, defineWorkspace, withSandbox) with a uniform SandboxHandle, workspace bootstrap, policy, and resumable lifecycle. |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-blaxel`        | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Blaxel sandbox provider for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside isolated Blaxel cloud sandboxes through the uniform SandboxHandle.                                                                                           |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-cloudflare`    | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Cloudflare sandbox provider for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside Cloudflare Containers (edge) through the uniform SandboxHandle.                                                                                          |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-daytona`       | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Daytona sandbox provider for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside isolated Daytona cloud sandboxes through the uniform SandboxHandle.                                                                                         |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-docker`        | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Docker sandbox providers for TanStack AI — dockerSandbox() runs a container; sbxSandbox() runs a Docker Sandboxes microVM.                                                                                                         |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-local-process` | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Local-process sandbox provider for TanStack AI — runs the agent directly on the host through the uniform SandboxHandle (no isolation; trusted/dev use).                                                                            |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-sprites`       | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Sprites sandbox provider for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside isolated Fly.io Sprite stateful sandboxes through the uniform SandboxHandle.                                                                                |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-upstash-box`   | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Upstash Box sandbox provider for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside isolated Upstash Box cloud sandboxes through the uniform SandboxHandle.                                                                                 |
| `@tanstack/ai-sandbox-vercel`        | —                                                                                                                                                                        | Vercel Sandbox provider for TanStack AI — run harness adapters inside isolated Vercel microVM sandboxes through the uniform SandboxHandle.                                                                                         |
